name: ServiceTitan
what_it_is: ServiceTitan helps contractors manage dispatch, scheduling, estimates and invoicing.
best_fit: Multi-truck residential and commercial trades comparing per-technician packages (Starter, Essentials, Works) with deep dispatch, pricebooks and batch accounting exports.
pricing_model: Per-technician packages (Starter, Essentials, Works) by quote, plus onboarding and accounting connector setup.
contract_verification_check: Quote/account verification required for minimum term, auto-renewal, per-tech floor, implementation fees and data export.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: Exports batches to QuickBooks Online, Desktop, Sage Intacct and Viewpoint Vista/Spectrum, or posts to an internal ledger. Direct API connectors and CSV journal routes handle invoice credits, customer deposits and business-unit GL mapping differently.
account_verification_check: Trace job identifiers, business-unit GL mapping, customer deposits, vendor PO bills and credit adjustments through your selected connector and batch export workflow.
operator_question_title: Who owns the ledger after the accounting export?
demo_script: Ask the demo operator to show the same completed job through the proposed QBO, Intacct or internal-ledger route, including a later credit and the journal entry you retain. Name the owner of export review and corrections for that selected route.
hold_condition: A journal download exists, but no one can identify which system owns the final balance or which later changes were reviewed.
owner_decision: Select the accounting architecture and its close owner before negotiating optional modules.

name: BuildOps
what_it_is: BuildOps supports commercial service and project work, connecting field and office workflows.
best_fit: Commercial mechanical, HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors running service and multi-phase project work together.
pricing_model: Custom per-user proposal across field technicians and office seats (typically multi-year terms) plus implementation.
contract_verification_check: Quote/account verification required for term, renewal notice, escalation, exit access and migration obligations.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: Connects to QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Sage Intacct, NetSuite and Viewpoint Spectrum/Vista, mapping GL accounts, classes, PO receipts and sales tax. Inventory stays outside the QBO integration. In API integrations, invoice PDF URLs populate only when invoices are emailed, and list-endpoint job statuses can lag detail records.
account_verification_check: Demonstrate PO receipts becoming bills, job/class mapping, returns, historical WIP cutoff snapshots and the separate inventory workflow in your exact accounting edition.
operator_question_title: Where do a receipt, return and inventory movement end up?
demo_script: Demonstrate one purchase receipt and its return through the quoted QuickBooks edition, with the intended bill or PO, job and class. Show the separately scoped inventory source rather than treating the integration as one complete inventory workflow.
hold_condition: The demo shows an invoice syncing but cannot explain the receipt, return or separate inventory balance for the same job.
owner_decision: Decide who maintains the inventory bridge, freezes month-end WIP cutoff snapshots and reviews PO receipt mapping.

name: Jobber
what_it_is: Jobber helps service businesses manage quotes, visits, jobs, invoices and payments.
best_fit: Residential and commercial service teams managing one-off and recurring jobs that want transparent self-serve pricing and built-in job costing.
pricing_model: Published Core ($29/mo annual, $39/mo monthly, 1 user), Connect ($99/mo annual, $119/mo monthly, up to 5 users), Grow ($149/mo annual, $199/mo monthly, up to 10 users) and Plus ($399/mo annual, $599/mo monthly, up to 15 users; $29/mo per extra user).
contract_verification_check: The pricing FAQ distinguishes no-commitment monthly, a 12-month commitment billed monthly and annual prepayment. It describes renewal and non-refundable annual payments. Confirm against the Terms of Service and your order.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: QuickBooks Online sync starts on Connect, while Job Costing requires Grow or Plus. One-off jobs use whole-job costing and recurring jobs use a trailing 30-day window. Syncing both billable items and expenses through the NEW QBO integration can double-count material costs, and customer work-order numbers in custom fields do not sync into QBO invoice descriptions by default.
account_verification_check: Confirm NEW versus legacy QBO connector, Grow/Plus job-costing eligibility, one-off versus 30-day recurring margin windows, and whether a material purchase recorded as both an item cost and expense double-counts.
operator_question_title: Can one material purchase appear twice in job cost?
demo_script: Use the current NEW or legacy connector and record the same representative material through the intended item-cost and expense paths. Show how the job total and QuickBooks result treat it, then show a later cost change.
hold_condition: The same material contributes twice to job cost, or the operator cannot identify the connector and direction of the later change.
owner_decision: Standardize one material-cost entry path and confirm whether recurring 30-day margins match your monthly P&L period.

name: Housecall Pro
what_it_is: Housecall Pro helps home-service teams manage customers, scheduling, jobs, invoices and payments.
best_fit: Home-service teams prioritizing fast dispatch, mobile invoicing and customer payment collection alongside QuickBooks.
pricing_model: Published Basic ($59/mo annual, $79/mo monthly, 1 user), Essentials ($149/mo annual, $189/mo monthly, up to 5 users) and MAX ($299/mo annual, $329/mo monthly, up to 8 users; $35/mo per extra user).
contract_verification_check: The pricing page advertises a free trial and monthly/annual billing. Quote/account verification required for cancellation, refunds and renewal terms in your selected subscription.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: QuickBooks Online sync and Job Costing start on Essentials; Open API and QuickBooks Desktop Web Connector require MAX. QBO sync is one-way from Housecall Pro to QBO and requires manual re-sync after later invoice edits. Native 'Invoices by Date' exports return grouped summaries rather than line-item invoice rows.
account_verification_check: Confirm Essentials/MAX QBO eligibility, one-way sync triggers, manual re-sync on post-export invoice edits, fully loaded labor-rate assumptions and line-item versus summary CSV exports. Desktop has separate setup documentation; verify edition and account availability.
operator_question_title: What happens after the original invoice has already synced?
demo_script: Follow one job to its invoice and payment, then demonstrate an authorized later invoice change in a safe demo account. Identify the current trigger and any manual re-sync needed. Review entered labor rates against the payroll-cost question separately.
hold_condition: The demo proves the first sync but cannot explain a later change; a configured labor rate is presented as proof that actual payroll costs reached the books.
owner_decision: Assign post-export invoice edit review and retain emailed full-detail CSV exports alongside QBO sync.

name: Joblogic
what_it_is: Joblogic manages field-service scheduling, jobs, assets, invoices and costs.
best_fit: Commercial maintenance and field-service contractors tracking assets, planned preventative maintenance (PPM), quotes and subcontractor work.
pricing_model: Published US plans: Standard ($65/user/mo annual), Premium ($95/user/mo annual) and Enterprise (custom, 20+ users). Confirm onboarding and API access in your quote.
contract_verification_check: Verify minimum term, renewal, onboarding, migration, export rights and API entitlement in the signed agreement.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: Joblogic documents connections to QuickBooks Online, Xero and Sage 50. Its QBO guide covers sales invoices, credit notes and payments, not supplier purchase invoices, and excludes QuickBooks Desktop. Internal job-cost records do not establish that supplier bills or payroll burden reach the ledger.
account_verification_check: Trace a sales invoice, credit note, payment and supplier purchase invoice for the same job. Name the CSV export/import or API route used to get supplier bills and labor costs into your general ledger.
operator_question_title: Does the supplier cost reach the same job in the books?
demo_script: Use one completed job with a sales invoice, payment and supplier invoice. Show the native sales sync, the separately scoped purchase-invoice route and the retained job identifier. If an API is proposed, demonstrate authorized access and reconcile the returned cost population.
hold_condition: The sales invoice arrives, but the supplier cost route or job mapping is still unexplained.
owner_decision: Choose the AP supplier-bill transfer route and its review owner before treating synced sales as a complete job-margin view.

name: FieldEdge
what_it_is: FieldEdge supports service dispatch, work orders, scheduling, technician time, purchases and QuickBooks connections.
best_fit: Mechanical, HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors wanting real-time two-way QuickBooks Online or Desktop sync with dispatch and service agreements.
pricing_model: Select, Premier and Elite per-technician plans by quote. Request full pricing for office/tech seats, onboarding, QuickBooks connector setup and optional modules.
contract_verification_check: Check the signed minimum term, renewal notice, price changes, migration scope and usable data exports before selecting a plan.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: FieldEdge lists real-time QuickBooks Online and Desktop connections on Select, Premier and Elite. Warehouse and truck inventory tracking is restricted to QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise with Advanced Inventory on the official plan comparison.
account_verification_check: Name the QuickBooks edition, plan and connector version. Trace an invoice, payment, purchase and later correction by job, then check what technician time contributes to accounting costs. operator_question_title: Check the accounting edition before testing the sync

Ask which records update automatically and which need an office action. Compare technician time with the cost that actually reaches the job.
hold_condition: The vendor demonstrates a different QuickBooks edition, or cannot show how a later correction affects both systems for the same job.
owner_decision: Verify your exact QuickBooks edition (especially if you need warehouse inventory) and assign an office owner for sync exceptions.

name: SubBase
what_it_is: SubBase manages commercial construction materials procurement, field material requests, multi-vendor RFQs, cost-coded purchase orders, delivery tickets and three-way invoice matching.
best_fit: Self-performing commercial contractors and specialty trade contractors in structural concrete, concrete restoration, plumbing, mechanical, electrical and drywall running centralized or semi-centralized materials procurement across field requests, RFQs, cost-coded purchase orders, delivery tickets and line-by-line three-way invoice matching.
pricing_model: Custom tiered company subscription by quote. SubBase FAQ states pricing is not per user or per project, and supplier portal messaging is free for vendors.
contract_verification_check: Confirm the company tier band, annual commitment, live ERP connector versus file-export scope, catalog onboarding support and desktop invoice approval permissions before signing.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: SubBase lists eight live ERP connections (QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Procore, Sage 300, Foundation, CMiC, Viewpoint Spectrum and Acumatica) where teams map projects, vendors and cost codes and toggle purchase-order and invoice sync, while Sage 100, Sage 100 Contractor, Viewpoint Vista, ComputerEase and TCM rely on manual one-way file exports. In file-export mode, clicking Download TCM or Download Foundation immediately marks the included orders as Synced in the browser, active screen filters restrict exported rows, and Download Foundation silently omits partially shipped and partially delivered orders.
account_verification_check: Confirm whether your ERP uses a live connection or manual file exports. During setup, clicking Approve Page accepts every AI mapping suggestion on screen in one click, and importing unmapped ERP records into SubBase is capped at 200 records per batch with no undo. On some Foundation connections, logging out of the integration deletes all mappings and sync history without a keep-mappings toggle.
operator_question_title: Test three-way match and ERP export rules on a partial delivery
demo_script: Run one material request from voice or photo capture through multi-vendor RFQ leveling, cost-coded purchase order creation, field delivery ticket photo logging and line-by-line three-way invoice matching against your ERP. Include a backorder or partial delivery, test active table filters before exporting, and verify how bulk AI mapping approvals and price variances are reviewed before payment.
hold_condition: Your ERP relies on file exports or Foundation and the team has not tested how partial deliveries, immediate Synced status on browser downloads or integration disconnects affect payable reconciliation.
owner_decision: Assign a centralized purchasing champion and require controller sign-off on initial AI cost-code mappings, catalog deduplication and three-way match exception thresholds before turning on invoice sync.

name: Kojo
what_it_is: Kojo manages commercial construction materials procurement, supplier quote comparison, distributor EDI ordering, warehouse and prefab inventory, tool tracking and three-way AP invoice matching.
best_fit: Commercial electrical, mechanical, plumbing, drywall, concrete, roofing and self-perform general contractors running high-volume distributor ordering, warehouse and prefab inventory, tool tracking and three-way AP invoice matching.
pricing_model: Custom company subscription by quote with unlimited users and unlimited data, scaled by contractor revenue and selected modules (Purchasing, Warehouse, Tool Tracking, Prefab and Kojo AP).
contract_verification_check: Confirm annual or multi-year term, revenue band, included modules (Warehouse, Tool Tracking, Prefab, Kojo AP), ERP and BuildOps connector scope and EDI supplier onboarding timelines before signing.
accounting_sync_and_gaps: Kojo documents direct integrations with 14 construction accounting and project management systems (QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Sage 100, Sage 300 CRE, Sage Intacct, Foundation, Viewpoint Vista, Viewpoint Spectrum, Deltek ComputerEase, Acumatica, CMiC, Access Coins Evo, eCMS and Procore), an integrated BuildOps Partner Network connection that ties material ordering, tracking and receiving to BuildOps jobs, plus CSV import/export for bills of materials, requisitions and raw EDI transaction logs.
account_verification_check: When pairing Kojo with BuildOps and an ERP (such as Sage Intacct, Spectrum, Vista, Foundation or QuickBooks), verify which system owns the purchase-order commitment and matched vendor bill sync so material costs are not double-posted across both connectors. Confirm how partial deliveries flow through Kojo AP's three-way match and whether warehouse stock transfers hit job cost on receipt or on job allocation.
operator_question_title: Trace a distributor EDI order and a BuildOps or warehouse handoff into job cost
demo_script: Walk one bill of materials from a BuildOps job or field requisition through supplier quote comparison or distributor EDI ordering, purchase order creation, partial delivery receipt and Kojo AP three-way invoice matching into your ERP. hold_condition: The demo shows catalog ordering but cannot trace how a partial delivery, warehouse stock transfer or BuildOps-to-Kojo-to-ERP purchase order avoids duplicate cost posting in your exact ERP edition.
owner_decision: Decide which modules (Purchasing, Warehouse, Tool Tracking, Prefab, Kojo AP) belong in phase one, designate a single system of record for ERP PO and AP bill sync when paired with BuildOps, and assign clear ownership for three-way match exceptions.
